integrity: All statements are supported by an analytic proof; finite checker output is supplementary. Publicly available 2026 manuscripts were accessible at abstract level only, leaving a stated historical-overlap risk. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns positive Euclidean orthotopes under a shared Haar-uniform projection normal. It does not classify arbitrary parallelotopes, general convex bodies, or the complete coupled distribution.
title: Sharp aspect-ratio phase diagram for width–brightness covariance of orthotopes
